page.layout: Top of page: one line of large spaced capitals, partly cut off at the right edge, with a smaller italic line beneath it. Below: a diagram of braces and boxes filling the left and centre of the page, with partial labels at the far left and right edges. Near the bottom: a short heading-like line in larger type, followed by two smaller lines and one line of text. No page number or catchword visible.

main_text.head: FORMA. Hic summa [illegible, ~12 letters]
main_text.p: Multiplex, in multa [illegible, ~8 letters] una forma. Hic [illegible, ~10 letters]

page.notes: The scan is faded, folded and cut at the right and left edges, so most diagram labels are partial. Several words are guesses from fragments and are marked [?]. The title line is cut off at the right edge and only partly legible. The first body line is a heading-style line in larger type, so it is set as a level 2 head. Greek and Hebrew: none visible. Possible show-through from the reverse side in the lower centre. The diagram boxes were read by their position and the brace structure, not by full words.
